title: Collection silently drops parameterized test IDs containing spaces
reasoning: The parser rejects every line containing a space, including valid parameterized node IDs explicitly supported by the coverage tests. These cases disappear from the collection count and hash. If execution stops before reaching such a case, inventory reconciliation cannot backfill its missing result, undermining complete checkpoint accounting.
reproduction: Parse 'tests/test_checkpoint_1.py::test_value[one two]\n'; the returned inventory is empty. Reconcile an execution that never produced that result; no missing failure is added.
recommendation: Collect structured node IDs or parse collection output without rejecting whitespace inside valid node IDs.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The supplied collection tests cover command construction and hash ordering, while whitespace-containing IDs are tested only in the coverage plugin.
suggestedRegressionTest: Extend collection scenarios with parameterized IDs containing whitespace and punctuation, and verify exact inventory membership, hashes, and missing-result backfilling.
minimumFixScope: Collection output parsing and collection inventory tests.
